description.text: Objectives The PhD program in Mechanical Engineering provides students with solid theory and the latest technological knowledge. The program has a practical orientation and aims to equip engineers with knowledge in modern experimental methods and research skills that allow them to meet the complexities of today’s challenges in the field of mechanical engineering. Students are expected to engage in high level scientific research, and to assume leadership role in their related fields. Duration Duration of program is between 3-4 years with course works in the first year, followed by a dissertation project. In a special case, duration of the program may be extended to 5 years with approval. Research Areas 1. Design and Manufacturing 2. Mechatronics and Automation 3. Fluid and Heat Transfer Credit Units Students need to successfully complete minimum 13 credits.

duration.text: The Mechanical Engineering at Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 5833 USD/per year ￥ 42000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2.Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3.Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4.Transcript of postgraduate school 5.Two recommendation letters From professor,associate professor or equivalents. 6. Study Plan in Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen Campus)

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2. Be Healthy. 3. Have attained a Master's diploma with good marks. 4. Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China. 5. Good English reading, writing and speaking skills.
